source.text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Mayo Lake
35 That portion of the Province in the vicinity of the Corporation of the City of Duncan, Quamichan Land District, which is contained within the following described boundaries: All that area bounded on the south by the southern boundary of Block 32, Cowichan Lake Land District; on the west by the Mayo Lake Road; on the north by the E. & N. Railway right of way; and on the east by the Skutz Falls Road.
